name: Eldraine
description: Eldraine, also called the Realm, is a fairy tale plane that holds the floating castle of Locthwain and the town of Edgewall.

timeline.summary: Syr Damon sees the faces of the dragon's innocent victims and his sword blazes like the sun.
timeline.quote: Syr Damon looked at the dragon and saw the faces of every innocent it had devoured.

citation.text: Righteousness (Throne of Eldraine, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Syr Tasdale declares he never wants to see the witch Ygretta again, and her familiars grant his wish.
timeline.quote: Syr Tasdale declared that he never wanted to see the witch Ygretta again.

citation.text: Revenge of Ravens (Throne of Eldraine, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ellwen vanishes from her locked chamber.
timeline.quote: By morning, the fire was out and Ellwen was gone.

citation.text: Escape to the Wilds (Throne of Eldraine, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Cursed by the fae, Hilda is turned into a cow at the market.
timeline.quote: The fae curse was turning out even worse than she had feared.

citation.text: Bartered Cow (Throne of Eldraine, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Korvold is transformed at his own wedding and eats the banquet, gifts and guests.
timeline.quote: Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.

citation.text: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King (Throne of Eldraine, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rowan and Will wonder whether a stag in a vision can lead them to their father.
timeline.quote: Could the stag in the vision lead them to their father?

citation.text: Unexplained Vision (Throne of Eldraine, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The fae king Reynald's wish is answered by the fae king.
timeline.quote: Reynald wished for an army to sweep away his enemies.

citation.text: Sorcerer's Broom (Throne of Eldraine, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the Wildered Quest an Eldraine archon watches and protects the Kenrith twins from redcaps.
timeline.quote: an archon watched the Kenrith twins from the trees and protected them from redcaps

citation.text: "Archon", section "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Questing Beast chooses Algenus Kenrith and Linden to quest; Algenus becomes High King.
timeline.quote: the Questing Beast chose the humble Algenus Kenrith and Linden to quest for the high rulership

citation.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko abducts the High King and turns him into a stag, and the courts struggle to coordinate against the Wilds.
timeline.quote: After the High King was abducted by Oko , the fey, around 4561 AR and turned into a stag

citation.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The royal twins find their father but their shared planeswalker spark ignites and sends them across the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: the Kenrith twins' shared Planeswalker's spark ignited, sending them across the Blind Eternities to a new plane.

citation.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mankind overthrows the Elven Lords, the five knightly courts are created, and Garenbrig is established around the Great Henge.
timeline.quote: The court of Garenbrig was established around the Great Henge .

citation.text: "Garenbrig", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko traps and mesmerizes Garruk, turning him into a slave bodyguard called Dog.
timeline.quote: Oko mesmerized Garruk, turning him into a slave bodyguard called Dog.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Oko's behest Garruk saves the Kenrith twins from Redcaps and kills the High King's guards before Oko kidnaps the king.
timeline.quote: Garruk killed the guards of the High King at Oko's behest

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk guards the prisoners while Oko prepares to have the High King killed as a stag.
timeline.quote: he was left to guard the prisoners

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Will removes the hedron from Garruk; the curse runs wild and Garruk rampages, injuring Cerise and killing Cado's corrupted griffin.
timeline.quote: As the hedron was removed from Garruk, the curse ran wild, driving him into a frenzy.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk is attacked by an abomination while crossing a river in the Wilds and kills it.
timeline.quote: he wrestled with the beast until he snapped its spine

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk falls into the river and sinks; Will dives in to save him and pulls him into a chalice.
timeline.quote: Will barely reached the surface, pulling the man into the large chalice

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The chalice pulls the curse from Garruk and gives him life; he carries Will to shore.
timeline.quote: the chalice had forcibly pulled the curse from his form

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk joins the twins in chasing the Wild Hunt to save their father, and Oko, disguised as Ayara, shoots the stag.
timeline.quote: Oko took the form of the elven queen Ayara and shot the stag in the chest with an arrow.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk tries to stop Oko but hesitates at Rowan's protest and Oko planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: all the time the man needed to planeswalk away to freedom

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk gives the twins' parents his word to find and watch over them, and leaves Eldraine.
timeline.quote: "They helped me. I will help them"

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dwarf-redcap feud boils over in the Assault on Delverhaugh.
timeline.quote: The feud boiled over in a massive food fight known as the Assault on Delverhaugh

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Four undines help Rowan Kenrith's group across a river to meet Indrelon in exchange for knowledge and secrets.
timeline.quote: Four undines assisted Rowan Kenrith 's group across a river to meet with Indrelon in exchange for knowledge and secrets.

citation.text: "Merfolk", section "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nightmares begin manifesting on Eldraine as a consequence of Ashiok's involvement in the Wicked Slumber, often taking the shape of the Phyrexian invaders.
timeline.quote: Nightmares began manifesting on Eldraine as a consequence of Ashiok's involvement in the Wicked Slumber .

citation.text: "Nightmare", section "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko meets the hedgewitch Alyse on Eldraine and later fathers Kellan, but leaves her after lashing out at the villagers.
timeline.quote: Oko met the human hedgewitch Alyse in a field of nightshade

citation.text: "Oko", section "Fathering Kellan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rowan and Will are born to a witch who kills the newborns for their blood; Linden gives up her sword's power to restore them and adopts them.
timeline.quote: their adoptive mother gave up her sword's power to restore life to the twins and took them in as her children

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The twins quest for their father, abducted by Oko and Garruk and transformed into a stag.
timeline.quote: he has been transformed into a stag

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Wild Hunt kills the stag, and Linden restores Algenus with his Questing Sword.
timeline.quote: bringing Algenus back to life by using his Questing Sword

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Learning the truth about their origins ignites the twins' spark and they planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: The shock ignites the twins' planeswalker's spark and they disappear.

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers Oko and Garruk Wildspeaker kidnap High King Algenus Kenrith, disrupting Eldraine's status quo.
timeline.quote: The status quo is disrupted when the planeswalkers Oko and Garruk Wildspeaker kidnap High King Algenus Kenrith .

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The twins Rowan and Will Kenrith embark on a quest to save their father.
timeline.quote: embark on a quest to save their father

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The king is saved, Garruk is freed from his curse, and the twins' spark ignites.
timeline.quote: In the end, the king is saved, Garruk is freed from his curse, and the twins' Planeswalker's spark ignites .

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko arrives on Eldraine and is attacked and wounded by Garruk.
timeline.quote: The fey planeswalker Oko has just arrived on Eldraine when he is attacked and wounded by Garruk Wildspeaker .

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Harvest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko traps Garruk in thorny vines and later mesmerizes him into a servile bodyguard.
timeline.quote: Oko mesmerizes him and turns him into a subservient bodyguard named

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Harvest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: High King Algenus prepares to leave on the Grand Procession.
timeline.quote: High King Algenus Kenrith is about to leave on the Grand Procession, his first-harvests tour of all five courts of the Realm.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Harvest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko disguises himself as Cado and wipes the twins' memory of their encounter.
timeline.quote: He disguises himself as Cado and deletes the memory of their encounter in the twin's minds.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Harvest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko abducts the High King.
timeline.quote: A bit later, he manages to abduct their father, the High King.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Harvest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk pledges to find and protect the twins.
timeline.quote: Garruk pledges to find them and protect them.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eight or nine generations before the Wildered Quest, mankind overthrows the Elven Lords, the five knightly courts are created, and Vantress is established around Indrelon.
timeline.quote: The court of Vantress was established around Indrelon .

citation.text: "Vantress", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan are born to a witch who kills the newborns for their blood; their adoptive mother restores them and raises them.
timeline.quote: Their birth mother killed the newborns for their blood, which she would have drunk to extend her life.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Will has a vision in the ice at seventeen.
timeline.quote: At seventeen, Will experienced a vision in a sheet of ice.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The vision". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The twins quest for their abducted father; Will rescues Garruk, summoning the Cauldron of Eternity which cures him.
timeline.quote: Later on, Will rescues Garruk from certain death.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The twins fail to protect the stag from the Wild Hunt; Linden restores the High King.
timeline.quote: bringing Algenus back to life by using his Questing Sword.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The shock of learning their origins ignites the twins' spark and they disappear.
timeline.quote: The shock ignites the twins' planeswalker's spark and they disappear.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Within days of the Phyrexian invasion the courts fall, the Kenriths die and Ayara is compleated.
timeline.quote: Within days of the Invasion, the courts of the Realm had fallen, the Kenriths were dead, and Ayara had been compleated , along with her guards.

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rankle's fellow faeries pretend to crown him, then trap him in a net and tell him nobody wants him there.
timeline.quote: "Nobody wants you here," Mags said.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle tries to attack when released; the faeries beat him and Mags pins and tears his wing, leaving him unable to fly.
timeline.quote: Rankle's wing was in tatters.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle is expelled from the glade and resolves to rob the first human he sees.
timeline.quote: He vowed to rob the first human that he saw.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle finds no flowers in the murky forest and heads back, nearly trampled by fleeing elk.
timeline.quote: a herd of elk burst out of the thicket and nearly trampled him

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian dog attacks Rankle and Torbran kills it with his axe.
timeline.quote: he opened his eyes and saw the beast in two halves and a red-bearded dwarf yanking his axe out of the carnage

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Torbran tells Rankle the courts have fallen and that they must stand at Locthwain; Rankle sees this as a chance to reach Ayara.
timeline.quote: "The courts have fallen," the dwarf said in a quivery voice.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle transforms Torbran's ring into a caterpillar and steals it while he sleeps.
timeline.quote: The ring had transformed into a caterpillar.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle uses the ring to wish for a basket of cookies and then a love potion, refusing to return it.
timeline.quote: "I wish for a love potion!" Rankle interrupted.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle's love potion makes the Phyrexian invaders chase him to their deaths, ending the Eldraine invasion.
timeline.quote: Rankle the fae used a Ring of Three Wishes to make a love potion rain down across Locthwain

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan meet the rebel knight Imodane, who calls herself queen and mocks Will as pathetic.
timeline.quote: "The only reason I agreed to this little meeting was to see if you were as pathetic as I'd heard."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Will proposes a duel: if Imodane loses she kneels; if she wins Will will surrender the crown of Eldraine to her.
timeline.quote: "I'll surrender the crown of Eldraine. You will be High Queen in name and deed."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Will freezes the ground and Imodane slips, but she melts the ice and knocks Will to the ground with her hammer.
timeline.quote: Flame bursts from the head of her hammer.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Terrified, Imodane drops her hammer and flees into the woods, while Will stares at Rowan in fear.
timeline.quote: Imodane drops the hammer, turns tail, and runs.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Rowan stays with Royse the weaver, who reveals her true eight-eyed form and directs her to an ancient castle.
timeline.quote: revealing eight eyes, two chittering mandibles, eight arms hidden beneath her stole.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Rowan finds the castle's library empty and collapses in rage and tears.
timeline.quote: Alone in the abandoned castle, Rowan Kenrith becomes a storm.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Rowan receives a letter from Will asking her to come home but refuses to return, sending him a blank page.
timeline.quote: "Give him this, and tell him to come find me if he's serious."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby climb a beanstalk with the guide Troyan, who gives them frog potions for the leap to the clouds.
timeline.quote: "Pretty cool, huh? Don't worry, it's only temporary," Troyan says.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ashiok frees Eriette from her cell, promising her new land far away, and she vanishes.
timeline.quote: "Opportunity calls us in a new direction.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Rowan declares she will rebuild Eldraine herself with power rather than negotiate with her brother.
timeline.quote: I will rebuild Eldraine myself—the old way, with power.

citation.text: Rowan, Scion of War (Wilds of Eldraine Promos, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Wicked Slumber saves Eldraine from Phyrexia but continues to spread after the invasion ends.
timeline.quote: The Wicked Slumber saved Eldraine from Phyrexia's grasp, but instead of fading when the invasion ended, it continued to spread.

citation.text: Dream Spoilers (Wilds of Eldraine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: On sleeping Eldraine Ashiok turns sleepers' nightmares against the awake and allies with Eriette.
timeline.quote: They allied with the witch Eriette , one of the authors of the curse.

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "On Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Castle Ardenvale Kellan restrains Ashiok and Will strikes them with an ice bolt, forcing them to planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: struck in the chest by an ice bolt from Will, forcing them to planeswalk to safety

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "On Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: Kellan was called to realm of the Fae Lord Talion

citation.text: "Kellan", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan slays Agatha by pushing her into her cauldron and rescues Imodane; the Wolf Knight is revealed to be Peter.
timeline.quote: Kellan slays the witch by pushing her into her cauldron

citation.text: "Kellan", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: informing them that Talion was also responsible for the curse

timeline.summary: Kellan helps Will Kenrith subdue Ashiok at Castle Ardenvale so Eriette is captured, though Rowan escapes.
timeline.quote: Kellan helped Will subdue the planeswalker

citation.text: "Kellan", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: where she revealed his father's identity as the planeswalker Oko

citation.text: "Kellan", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko traps Garruk in thorn vines and mesmerizes him into a slave bodyguard called Dog.
